operations.name: Add leads in bulk to a campaign or list

list_id.description: The unique identifier for the list to add leads to. Use this field OR `campaign_id`, but not both.

operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `lead-labels:update`, `lead-labels:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

id.description: The ID of the item to update

label.description: Display label for the custom lead label

interest_status_label.description: Interest status label associated with this label

description.description: Detailed description of the custom lead label purpose

use_with_ai.description: Whether this label should be used with AI features

operations.name: Patch lead list
operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `lead_lists:update`, `lead_lists:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

id.description: The ID of the item to update

has_enrichment_task.description: Whether this list runs the enrichment process on every added lead or not

owned_by.description: User ID of the owner of this lead list. Defaults to the user that created the list

operations.name: Patch webhook
operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `webhooks:update`, `webhooks:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

id.description: The ID of the item to update

campaign.description: Optional campaign UUID to filter events (null = all campaigns in workspace)

name.description: Optional user-defined name for the webhook

target_hook_url.description: Target URL to send webhook payloads

event_type.description: Type of event to trigger the webhook (null for custom label events). Set to "all_events" to subscribe to all events - including custom label events

custom_interest_value.description: Custom interest value - corresponds to LeadLabel.interest_status (used for custom label events)

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to include when delivering webhook payloads (key-value pairs)

operations.name: Patch workspace
operations.description: Update your current workspace details. Note that this endpoint doesn't require any parameters. It will update the workspace based on the API key sent in the headers. Requires one of the following scopes: `workspaces:update`, `workspaces:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

operations.name: Patch workspace member
operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `workspace_members:update`, `workspace_members:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

id.description: The ID of the item to update

role.description: THe role of the workspace member defining their access level. While the "owner" role is listed in the enum, it cannot be created via the API, and is only assigned to the user who creates the workspace.

operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `accounts:update`, `accounts:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

email.description: The email of the account to pause

operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `campaigns:update`, `campaigns:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

id.description: Campaign ID

id.description: Subsequence ID

operations.name: Get pre warmed up domains
operations.description: This endpoint will return a list of pre-warmed up domains available for order.These domains are set up and configured in advance, allowing for quick deployment of email services.Use this endpoint to retrieve available pre-warmed up domains before placing an order.IMPORTANT: if the endpoint returns a list of empty domains - it's not a bug, please don't retry right away or report this as a bug - it

extensions.description: A list of domain extensions to filter the results by. If not provided, all available extensions will be returned.

search.description: A search string to filter the domains by. This can be a partial or full domain name.

operations.name: Preview leads from supersearch
operations.description: Preview the leads matching a SuperSearch query without enriching them Requires one of the following scopes: `supersearch_enrichments:read`, `supersearch_enrichments:all`, `all:read`, `all:all`

skip_owned_leads.description: Skip leads that belong to the current workspace

show_one_lead_per_company.description: Return only one lead per company

operations.name: Remove a lead from a subsequence
operations.description: Remove a lead from a subsequence Requires one of the following scopes: `leads:update`, `leads:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

id.description: The ID of the lead to remove from the subsequence.

operations.name: Reply to an email
operations.description: Send a reply to an email. This endpoint can be used to send an email only as a reply to an existing email. In order to reply to an email, please specify the `reyply_to_uuid` field, and your email will be sent as a reply to that email. The `reyply_to_uuid` field represents the `id` field of an existing email, which is being returned to you in all the `/email` endpoints Requires one of the following

eaccount.description: The email account that will be used to send this email. It has to be an email account connected to your workspace

reply_to_uuid.description: The id of the email to reply to

subject.description: Subject line of the email message

body.description: The email body. You can specify either the `html` or the `text` field, or both

cc_address_email_list.description: Comma-separated list of CC email addresses

bcc_address_email_list.description: Comma-separated list of BCC email addresses

reminder_ts.description: If provided then a reminder will be attached to this email, you will see this reminder in the Unibox in the web app

assigned_to.description: The user id assigned to the lead

operations.name: Resume a paused account
operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `accounts:update`, `accounts:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

operations.name: Resume a paused subsequence
operations.description: Resume a paused subsequence Requires one of the following scopes: `subsequences:update`, `subsequences:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

id.description: The ID of the subsequence to resume.

operations.name: Resume a webhook
operations.description: Resume a webhook that was disabled due to repeated delivery failures Requires one of the following scopes: `webhooks:update`, `webhooks:all`, `all:update`, `all:all`

operations.name: Run enrichment for resource
operations.description: Run all enrichments associated with a resource for a list of leads or for all the leads that haven't been enriched yet

resource_id.description: The ID of the resource (list or campaign) to run enrichments for

lead_ids.description: List of lead IDs to enrich (optional)

limit.description: If set, only the first N leads will be enriched

overwrite.description: (AI re-run parameter) If true, run even if column has value. If false (default), only process empty/null columns. Requires column_name.

starting_row.description: (AI re-run parameter) Starting lead position (inclusive, 1-indexed). Defaults to 1 if not provided. Requires column_name.

count.description: (AI re-run parameter) How many leads to process. If not provided, processes all remaining leads from starting_row to the end. Requires column_name.

operations.name: Search campaigns by lead email
operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `campaigns:read`, `campaigns:all`, `all:read`, `all:all`

operations.name: Send a test email
operations.description: Send a preview/test email without creating an email entity in Unibox. Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per workspace. Requires one of the following scopes: `emails:create`, `emails:all`, `all:create`, `all:all`

eaccount.description: The email account that will be used to send this email. It has to be an email account connected to your workspace.

to_address_email_list.description: Comma-separated list of recipients that will receive the test email.

subject.description: Subject line of the test email.

body.description: HTML body of the test email.

operations.name: Share a campaign
operations.description: Share a campaign. This allows other users to create new campaigns based on this campaign. The campaign is being shared for 7 days, after which you'll have to call this endpoint again if you want to enable sharing on the campaign

id.description: Campaign ID

operations.name: Test account vitals
operations.description: Requires one of the following scopes: `accounts:read`, `accounts:all`, `all:read`, `all:all`

operations.name: Test ai reply label prediction
operations.description: Returns the AI-predicted lead label for a reply text. This simulates how AI auto-tagging would label an incoming reply for testing custom labels and descriptions. Rate limit: 500 requests per 30 days per workspace. This rate limit applies only to this testing endpoint; live reply processing does not use this limiter. Requires one of the following scopes: `lead-labels:read`, `lead-labels:all`, `all

operations.name: Test a webhook
operations.description: Send a test payload to a webhook URL to verify it is working

operations.name: Assign or unassign tags to resources
operations.description: This can be used for both accounts and campaigns. Please check the `resource_type` field for more information.

tag_ids.description: The list of tag ids to assign or unassign

resource_type.description: The resource type to assign or unassign the tags to

resource_ids.description: The list of resource ids to assign or unassign. A resource id is the id of an account or a campaign.

assign.description: Whether to assign the tags to the resources.

filter.description: The filter to apply to the resources. These are only used when `selected_all` is true.

operations.name: Update enrichment settings for resource
operations.description: Update auto-update and skip settings for a SuperSearch enrichment tied to a specific resource Requires one of the following scopes: `supersearch_enrichments:create`, `supersearch_enrichments:all`, `all:create`, `all:all`

resource_id.description: Unique identifier for the resource (list or campaign)

auto_update.description: Whether new leads added to the resource will be automatically enriched

skip_rows_without_email.description: Whether the fully enriched profile enrichment will run even if we don't find an email

operations.name: Update the interest status of a lead
operations.description: Update the interest status of a lead

lead_email.description: The email of the lead to update the interest status of.

interest_value.description: Set this field to "null" to reset the lead value to "Lead". This is the same as moving the lead to the "Lead" status in the web app. Please check the `lt_interest_status` field for the list of possible values.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to update the interest status of.

ai_interest_value.description: The AI interest value to set for the lead.

disable_auto_interest.description: Whether to disable the auto interest.

list_id.description: The ID of the list to update the interest status of.
